verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat bhai chalanaa hoi paahunichaaree|

en.bdb: Considering himself a guest, the sikh spends his life in loving devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਗਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: chalan jaan ajaan hoi gahu garab nivaaree|

en.bdb: They (Sikhs) remain unknown to deceit and pull out ego from their minds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਿਤ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਏਹੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh nit paraahune eh karanee saaree|

en.bdb: Their true conduct is to treat themselves as guests in this world.
The object of the Gurmukh is service and only such action is loved by the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸੁਧਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi paravaar sudhaaree|

en.bdb: Merging consciousness in the Word they reform the whole family (in the form of world).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat jai sahaj ghar niramal nira(n)kaaree ||4||

en.bdb: Through holy congregation they become pure and formless and get established in the final stage of equipoise.
